form.label: pfSense Filterlog Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for pfSense filterlog TCP, UDP, and ICMP CSV firewall records. Dashboard presence does not imply replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | search vendor="pfSense" product="filterlog" | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | search action="pass" | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | search action="block" | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | stats dc(tracker) as tracked_rules
index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | timechart count by sourcetype

index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | eval action_direction=coalesce(action,"unknown")." / ".coalesce(direction,"unknown") | top limit=12 action_direction
index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | eval protocol=coalesce(protocol,transport,"unknown") | top limit=12 protocol
index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | eval firewall_interface=coalesce(interface,src_interface,"unknown") | top limit=12 firewall_interface

index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | eval src=coalesce(src,src_ip,"unknown"), dest=coalesce(dest,dest_ip,"unknown") | stats count values(action) as actions values(direction) as directions values(protocol) as protocols values(dest_port) as dest_ports values(tracker) as trackers by src dest | sort - count | head 25

index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | search action="block" | table _time host sourcetype action direction interface src src_ip src_port dest dest_ip dest_port protocol transport rule rule_number tracker signature signature_id reason _raw | sort - _time | head 75

index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | eval src=coalesce(src,src_ip,"unknown"), dest=coalesce(dest,dest_ip,"unknown") | stats count values(action) as actions values(direction) as directions values(interface) as interfaces values(src) as sources values(dest) as destinations values(dest_port) as dest_ports values(protocol) as protocols by tracker rule rule_number reason | sort - count | head 50

index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | eval protocol=coalesce(protocol,transport,"unknown") | table _time sourcetype action direction protocol src src_ip src_port dest dest_ip dest_port tcp_flags data_length length tracker marker _raw | sort - _time | head 75

table.title: Onboarding coverage by source, host, and sourcetype

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | stats count dc(tracker) as distinct_trackers values(action) as actions values(direction) as directions min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

index=$index$ sourcetype="pfsense:filterlog*" host=$host_filter$ | extract reload=true | table _time host source sourcetype action direction interface src src_ip src_port dest dest_ip dest_port protocol transport tracker rule rule_number reason signature signature_id marker _raw | sort - _time | head 100
